<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">
<title>地铁跑酷 - Subway Runner</title>
<style>
* { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
body { background: #000; overflow: hidden; touch-action: none; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; }
canvas { display: block; margin: 0 auto; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
// ============================================================
// 地铁跑酷 - Subway Runner (无限跑酷网页游戏)
// ============================================================

const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

// ---- 响应式画布 ----
function resize() {
  const w = window.innerWidth;
  const h = window.innerHeight;
  const aspect = 9 / 16;
  if (w / h > aspect) {
    canvas.height = h;
    canvas.width = h * aspect;
  } else {
    canvas.width = w;
    canvas.height = w / aspect;
  }
  canvas.style.width = canvas.width + 'px';
  canvas.style.height = canvas.height + 'px';
}
resize();
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

const W = () => canvas.width;
const H = () => canvas.height;

// ============================================================
// 音效引擎 (Web Audio API)
// ============================================================
let audioCtx = null;
function initAudio() {
  if (!audioCtx) audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
}
function playTone(freq, type, duration, vol = 0.1, glide = 0) {
  if (!audioCtx) return;
  const t = audioCtx.currentTime;
  const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
  const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
  osc.type = type;
  osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t);
  if (glide) osc.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(freq + glide, t + duration);
  gain.gain.setValueAtTime(vol, t);
  gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t + duration);
  osc.connect(gain);
  gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
  osc.start(t);
  osc.stop(t + duration);
}
function sfxCoin() { playTone(880, 'square', 0.08, 0.08); setTimeout(() => playTone(1320, 'square', 0.06, 0.06), 60); }
function sfxHit() { playTone(80, 'sawtooth', 0.25, 0.15); }
function sfxJump() { playTone(300, 'sine', 0.15, 0.06, 400); }
function sfxSlide() { playTone(200, 'triangle', 0.1, 0.04, -100); }
function sfxPowerup() { playTone(660, 'sine', 0.12, 0.08); setTimeout(() => playTone(880, 'sine', 0.12, 0.08), 100); setTimeout(() => playTone(1100, 'sine', 0.15, 0.1), 200); }
function sfxDeath() { playTone(200, 'sawtooth', 0.4, 0.12); setTimeout(() => playTone(150, 'sawtooth', 0.4, 0.12), 150); setTimeout(() => playTone(100, 'sawtooth', 0.6, 0.2), 300); }
function sfxHeal() { playTone(523, 'sine', 0.15, 0.08); setTimeout(() => playTone(659, 'sine', 0.15, 0.08), 100); setTimeout(() => playTone(784, 'sine', 0.2, 0.1), 200); }
function sfxTrainHorn() { playTone(150, 'sawtooth', 0.6, 0.1); playTone(120, 'sawtooth', 0.5, 0.1); }

// ============================================================
// 透视系统
// ============================================================
const PERSPECTIVE = {
  vanishX: 0.5,       // 消失点X (0-1, 屏幕比例)
  vanishY: 0.18,      // 消失点Y (屏幕比例)
  playerScreenY: 0.78, // 玩家所在屏幕Y比例
  groundBase: 0.92,    // 地面底部
  // 透视缩放: screenY -> scale (远处小, 近处大)
  scaleAt(y) {
    const vY = H() * this.vanishY;
    const bY = H() * this.groundBase;
    if (y <= vY) return 0.15;
    const t = (y - vY) / (bY - vY);
    return 0.15 + t * 0.85;
  },
  // 世界坐标 -> 屏幕坐标
  worldToScreen(wx, wy) {
    // wx: 跑道 (-1, 0, 1) / wy: 深度 (0=远处, 1=近处)
    const vX = W() * this.vanishX;
    const vY = H() * this.vanishY;
    const bY = H() * this.groundBase;
    const sy = vY + wy * (bY - vY);
    const laneWidth = W() * 0.12 * this.scaleAt(sy);
    const sx = vX + wx * laneWidth * 3;
    return { x: sx, y: sy, scale: this.scaleAt(sy) };
  }
};

// ============================================================
// 游戏状态
// ============================================================
const STATE = {
  MENU: 'menu',
  PLAYING: 'playing',
  DEAD: 'dead'
};

let gameState = STATE.MENU;
let score = 0;
let highScore = parseInt(localStorage.getItem('subwayHighScore')) || 0;
let distance = 0;
let speed = 0;          // 基础速度
let currentSpeed = 0;   // 当前实际速度(受坡度影响)
let slopeValue = 0;     // 当前坡度 (-1到1)
let targetSlope = 0;    // 目标坡度
let slopeTimer = 0;     // 坡度计时器
let frameCount = 0;
let shakeTimer = 0;
let shakeIntensity = 0;
let slowMotion = 0;     // 慢动作计时

// 场景偏移(用于视差)
let sceneOffset = 0;
// 轨道偏移(移动纹理)
let trackOffset = 0;

// ============================================================
// 玩家
// ============================================================
const PLAYER = {
  lane: 0,           // -1, 0, 1 (左中右)
  targetLane: 0,
  laneSwitchSpeed: 0.15, // 跑道切换平滑过渡
  currentLaneX: 0,   // 当前实际X (平滑过渡用)
  y: 0.78,           // 屏幕Y比例(基础位置)
  vy: 0,             // 垂直速度(跳跃用)
  isJumping: false,
  isSliding: false,
  slideTimer: 0,
  jumpHeight: 0,
  animFrame: 0,
  animTimer: 0,
  invincible: 0,     // 无敌时间
  hp: 3,
  maxHp: 3,
  // 道具状态
  magnetActive: false,
  magnetTimer: 0,
  doubleCoin: false,
  doubleCoinTimer: 0,
  skateboard: false,
  skateboardTimer: 0,
  // 火车顶状态
  onTrain: null,     // 当前所在的火车引用
  trainRideX: 0,
};

function resetPlayer() {
  PLAYER.lane = 0;
  PLAYER.targetLane = 0;
  PLAYER.currentLaneX = 0;
  PLAYER.y = 0.78;
  PLAYER.vy = 0;
  PLAYER.isJumping = false;
  PLAYER.isSliding = false;
  PLAYER.slideTimer = 0;
  PLAYER.jumpHeight = 0;
  PLAYER.animFrame = 0;
  PLAYER.animTimer = 0;
  PLAYER.invincible = 0;
  PLAYER.hp = 3;
  PLAYER.magnetActive = false;
  PLAYER.magnetTimer = 0;
  PLAYER.doubleCoin = false;
  PLAYER.doubleCoinTimer = 0;
  PLAYER.skateboard = false;
  PLAYER.skateboardTimer = 0;
  PLAYER.onTrain = null;
  PLAYER.trainRideX = 0;
}

// ============================================================
// 障碍物 & 道具 & 火车 池
// ============================================================
let obstacles = [];
let powerups = [];
let trains = [];
let particles = [];
let sceneryItems = []; // 远处装饰物

// 生成控制
let spawnTimer = 0;
let spawnInterval = 2.0;  // 基础生成间隔(秒)
let powerupSpawnTimer = 0;
let trainSpawnTimer = 0;
let nextTrainTime = 8;

// 已跑距离(用于恢复血量等)
let totalDistanceTraveled = 0;
let lastHealDistance = 0;

// ============================================================
// 障碍物定义
// ============================================================
const OBSTACLE_TYPES = {
  barrier:   { name: '道口栏杆', height: 0, sprite: 'barrier',   color: '#e74c3c' },
  pipe:      { name: '横放铁管', height: 0, sprite: 'pipe',      color: '#95a5a6' },
  fence:     { name: '低矮围栏', height: 0, sprite: 'fence',     color: '#f39c12' },
  signalBox: { name: '信号灯箱', height: 1, sprite: 'signalBox', color: '#2c3e50' },
  tiesPile:  { name: '枕木堆',   height: 1, sprite: 'tiesPile',  color: '#8B4513' },
  cone:      { name: '施工锥桶', height: 1, sprite: 'cone',      color: '#ff6600' },
  maintCart: { name: '维修车',   height: 2, sprite: 'maintCart', color: '#f1c40f' },
  towerBase: { name: '信号塔基座', height: 2, sprite: 'tower',   color: '#7f8c8d' },
  worker:    { name: '维修工人', height: 2, sprite: 'worker',    color: '#ff6600' },
};

// 每类障碍需要什么操作: 0=滑铲, 1=跳跃, 2=换道
const OBSTACLE_ACTION = {
  barrier: 0, pipe: 0, fence: 0,
  signalBox: 1, tiesPile: 1, cone: 1,
  maintCart: 2, towerBase: 2, worker: 2,
};

// ============================================================
// 道具定义
// ============================================================
const POWERUP_TYPES = {
  coin:       { name: '金币',   color: '#f1c40f', effect: 'coin' },
  coinSilver: { name: '银币',   color: '#bdc3c7', effect: 'coin' },
  medkit:     { name: '医疗包', color: '#e74c3c', effect: 'heal' },
  magnet:     { name: '磁铁',   color: '#3498db', effect: 'magnet' },
  doubleCoin: { name: '双倍金币', color: '#f39c12', effect: 'doubleCoin' },
  skateboard: { name: '滑板',   color: '#2ecc71', effect: 'skateboard' },
};

// ============================================================
// 辅助函数
// ============================================================
function rand(min, max) { return Math.random() * (max - min) + min; }
function randInt(min, max) { return Math.floor(rand(min, max + 1)); }
function lerp(a, b, t) { return a + (b - a) * t; }
function clamp(v, min, max) { return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, v)); }

// 检测碰撞: 两个对象在屏幕空间重叠
function checkCollision(obj) {
  const pw = PERSPECTIVE;
  const pSy = H() * PLAYER.y + PLAYER.jumpHeight * H() * 0.12;
  const pSx = W() * 0.5 + PLAYER.currentLaneX * W() * 0.12 * pw.scaleAt(pSy) * 3;
  const pScale = pw.scaleAt(pSy);
  const pHalfW = W() * 0.04 * pScale;
  const pHalfH = H() * 0.05 * pScale;

  // 玩家碰撞箱(缩一点的)
  const pLeft = pSx - pHalfW * 0.6;
  const pRight = pSx + pHalfW * 0.6;
  const pTop = pSy - pHalfH * (PLAYER.isSliding ? 0.3 : 0.8);
  const pBottom = pSy + pHalfH * 0.5;

  const oSy = obj.screenY;
  const oLaneX = (obj.lane || 0);
  const oScale = pw.scaleAt(oSy);
  const laneW = W() * 0.12 * oScale * 3;
  const oSx = W() * 0.5 + oLaneX * laneW;
  const oHalfW = obj.halfWidth || (W() * 0.035 * oScale);
  const oHalfH = obj.halfHeight || (H() * 0.04 * oScale);

  const oLeft = oSx - oHalfW * 0.7;
  const oRight = oSx + oHalfW * 0.7;
  const oTop = oSy - oHalfH * 0.7;
  const oBottom = oSy + oHalfH * 0.7;

  return !(pRight < oLeft || pLeft > oRight || pBottom < oTop || pTop > oBottom);
}

// ============================================================
// 生成障碍物
// ============================================================
function spawnObstacle() {
  const types = Object.keys(OBSTACLE_TYPES);
  const typeName = types[randInt(0, types.length - 1)];
  const type = OBSTACLE_TYPES[typeName];
  const lane = randInt(-1, 1);

  // 检查是否已有障碍物在附近(避免堆叠)
  for (const o of obstacles) {
    if (o.lane === lane && o.worldY > 0.85) return; // 太近，跳过
  }

  obstacles.push({
    type: typeName,
    lane: lane,
    worldY: 0.02,     // 远处生成
    screenY: 0,
    color: type.color,
    action: OBSTACLE_ACTION[typeName],
    halfWidth: W() * 0.035,
    halfHeight: H() * 0.04,
    passed: false,
    wobble: rand(0, Math.PI * 2),
  });
}

function spawnPowerup() {
  const types = Object.keys(POWERUP_TYPES);
  const weights = [30, 20, 8, 12, 12, 10]; // 权重: 金币最常见
  const totalW = weights.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  let r = rand(0, totalW);
  let idx = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < weights.length; i++) {
    r -= weights[i];
    if (r <= 0) { idx = i; break; }
  }
  const typeName = types[idx];
  const type = POWERUP_TYPES[typeName];
  const lane = randInt(-1, 1);

  powerups.push({
    type: typeName,
    lane: lane,
    worldY: 0.02,
    screenY: 0,
    color: type.color,
    effect: type.effect,
    halfWidth: W() * 0.03,
    halfHeight: H() * 0.035,
    rotation: 0,
    bobOffset: rand(0, Math.PI * 2),
  });
}

function spawnTrain() {
  const isLong = Math.random() < 0.35;
  const numCars = isLong ? randInt(4, 6) : randInt(1, 2);
  const lane = randInt(-1, 1);
  const colors = ['#c0392b', '#2980b9', '#27ae60', '#f39c12', '#1a1a1a'];
  const color = colors[randInt(0, colors.length - 1)];
  const isClimbable = !isLong && Math.random() < 0.4; // 短火车才有可攀爬的

  // 检查附近没有火车
  for (const t of trains) {
    if (t.lane === lane && t.worldY > 0.5) return;
  }

  trains.push({
    lane: lane,
    worldY: 0.02,
    screenY: 0,
    numCars: numCars,
    color: color,
    isLong: isLong,
    climbable: isClimbable,
    halfWidth: W() * 0.05,
    hornTimer: rand(0.5, 2.0),
    lightOn: true,
    lightTimer: 0,
    graffiti: randInt(0, 3),
  });
}

// ============================================================
// 粒子系统
// ============================================================
function spawnParticles(x, y, count, color, speed = 2) {
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const angle = rand(0, Math.PI * 2);
    const spd = rand(speed * 0.5, speed);
    particles.push({
      x, y,
      vx: Math.cos(angle) * spd,
      vy: Math.sin(angle) * spd - rand(1, 4),
      life: rand(0.3, 0.8),
      maxLife: 0.8,
      color: color,
      size: rand(2, 5),
    });
  }
}

// ============================================================
// 游戏流程
// ============================================================
function startGame() {
  initAudio();
  resetPlayer();
  obstacles = [];
  powerups = [];
  trains = [];
  particles = [];
  sceneryItems = [];
  score = 0;
  distance = 0;
  totalDistanceTraveled = 0;
  lastHealDistance = 0;
  speed = 280;         // 基础速度(像素/秒 等效)
  currentSpeed = 280;
  slopeValue = 0;
  targetSlope = 0;
  slopeTimer = 0;
  spawnTimer = 0;
  powerupSpawnTimer = 0;
  trainSpawnTimer = 0;
  nextTrainTime = 6 + rand(0, 4);
  sceneOffset = 0;
  trackOffset = 0;
  shakeTimer = 0;
  shakeIntensity = 0;
  slowMotion = 0;
  gameState = STATE.PLAYING;

  // 生成初始远景色
  generateScenery();
}

function generateScenery() {
  sceneryItems = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
    sceneryItems.push({
      x: rand(0.05, 0.95),
      y: rand(0.05, 0.25),
      size: rand(15, 45),
      type: randInt(0, 2), // 0=建筑, 1=树, 2=起重机
      color: `hsl(${randInt(190, 260)}, ${randInt(20, 50)}%, ${randInt(20, 50)}%)`,
    });
  }
}

function gameOver() {
  gameState = STATE.DEAD;
  sfxDeath();
  shakeIntensity = 8;
  shakeTimer = 0.4;
  slowMotion = 0.6;
  if (score > highScore) {
    highScore = score;
    localStorage.setItem('subwayHighScore', highScore);
  }
}

// ============================================================
// 渲染: 天空 & 城市背景
// ============================================================
function drawSky() {
  const h = H();
  const vY = h * PERSPECTIVE.vanishY;
  // 天空渐变: 顶部深蓝 -> 消失点浅蓝
  const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, vY);
  grad.addColorStop(0, '#1a1a4e');
  grad.addColorStop(0.4, '#2d3a7a');
  grad.addColorStop(0.7, '#5b8cbe');
  grad.addColorStop(1, '#a8d8ea');
  ctx.fillStyle = grad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W(), vY);

  // 太阳/光晕
  const sunX = W() * 0.75 + sceneOffset * 0.03;
  const sunY = h * 0.05;
  const sunGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(sunX, sunY, W() * 0.02, sunX, sunY, W() * 0.12);
  sunGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,200,0.9)');
  sunGrad.addColorStop(0.3, 'rgba(255,200,150,0.4)');
  sunGrad.addColorStop(0.7, 'rgba(255,150,100,0.1)');
  sunGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,100,50,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = sunGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W(), vY);
}

function drawCitySkyline() {
  const h = H();
  const vY = h * PERSPECTIVE.vanishY;
  const w = W();

  // 远距离建筑(小，缓慢视差)
  for (const s of sceneryItems) {
    if (s.y > vY / h) continue;
    const sy = s.y * h;
    const sx = (s.x * w + sceneOffset * 0.02 * (1 - s.y * 3)) % w;
    const sz = s.size * (0.5 + s.y * 1.5);

    ctx.fillStyle = s.color;
    if (s.type === 0) {
      // 建筑
      ctx.fillRect(sx - sz * 0.3, sy - sz, sz * 0.6, sz);
      // 窗户
      const winColor = 'rgba(255,255,200,0.6)';
      ctx.fillStyle = winColor;
      for (let wy = sy - sz + sz * 0.1; wy < sy; wy += sz * 0.2) {
        for (let wx = sx - sz * 0.2; wx < sx + sz * 0.2; wx += sz * 0.15) {
          if (Math.random() > 0.4) ctx.fillRect(wx, wy, sz * 0.06, sz * 0.08);
        }
      }
    } else if (s.type === 1) {
      // 简化的树
      ctx.fillStyle = '#2d5016';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(sx, sy - sz * 0.6, sz * 0.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#4a3520';
      ctx.fillRect(sx - sz * 0.04, sy - sz * 0.3, sz * 0.08, sz * 0.3);
    } else {
      // 起重机
      ctx.strokeStyle = s.color;
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(sx, sy);
      ctx.lineTo(sx, sy - sz);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(sx - sz * 0.3, sy - sz * 0.7);
      ctx.lineTo(sx, sy - sz);
      ctx.lineTo(sx + sz * 0.4, sy - sz * 0.4);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }
}

// ============================================================
// 渲染: 地形 (轨道、枕木、碎石、高架桥墩)
// ============================================================
function drawTerrain() {
  const h = H();
  const w = W();
  const vY = h * PERSPECTIVE.vanishY;
  const bY = h * PERSPECTIVE.groundBase;
  const vX = w * PERSPECTIVE.vanishX;
  const slopeOffset = slopeValue * h * 0.12; // 坡度对消失点的偏移

  // 地面区域
  const groundTop = vY + slopeOffset;

  // ---- 碎石地面 ----
  const groundGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, groundTop, 0, bY);
  groundGrad.addColorStop(0, '#8a8a7a');
  groundGrad.addColorStop(0.3, '#9e9e8e');
  groundGrad.addColorStop(0.7, '#7a7a6a');
  groundGrad.addColorStop(1, '#5a5a4a');
  ctx.fillStyle = groundGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, groundTop, w, bY - groundTop);

  // 碎石纹理
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(180,175,160,0.3)';
  const gravelStep = h * 0.015;
  for (let gy = groundTop + (trackOffset % gravelStep); gy < bY; gy += gravelStep) {
    for (let gx = 0; gx < w; gx += gravelStep * 1.5) {
      if (Math.random() > 0.65) {
        const gs = gravelStep * 0.3 * ((gy - groundTop) / (bY - groundTop));
        ctx.fillRect(gx, gy, gs, gs);
      }
    }
  }

  // ---- 高架桥墩 ----
  if (slopeValue > 0.15) {
    const pierCount = 4;
    const pierSpacing = w / pierCount;
    for (let px = pierSpacing * 0.3; px < w; px += pierSpacing) {
      const pierH = slopeValue * h * 0.2;
      const pierTop = groundTop;
      const pierBot = groundTop + pierH;
      const pierW = w * 0.015;

      ctx.fillStyle = '#5a5a5a';
      ctx.fillRect(px - pierW, pierTop, pierW * 2, pierH);

      // 横梁
      ctx.fillStyle = '#4a4a4a';
      ctx.fillRect(px - pierW * 2, pierTop, pierW * 4, pierW * 1.5);
      ctx.fillRect(px - pierW * 1.5, pierBot - pierW, pierW * 3, pierW);
    }
  }

  // ---- 三条铁轨 ----
  const lanes = [-1, 0, 1];
  for (const lane of lanes) {
    // 铁轨透视: 从消失点辐射
    const railSpread = w * 0.06;
    const railX1 = vX + lane * railSpread * 3;
    const railX2 = railX1 + railSpread;

    // 每条轨道的两根钢轨
    for (const offset of [0, 1]) {
      const rx = offset === 0 ? railX1 : railX2;
      const railBottomX = vX + (rx - vX) * (bY - groundTop) / (bY - groundTop) * (bY / h);

      // 绘制钢轨(近处粗远处细)
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#7f8c8d';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(rx, groundTop);
      // 计算底部X(透视发散)
      const dx = rx - vX;
      const botX = vX + dx * ((bY - vX) / (groundTop - vX || 1));
      ctx.lineTo(botX, bY);
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
      ctx.stroke();

      // 轨顶高光
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#bdc3c7';
      ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(rx - 0.5, groundTop);
      ctx.lineTo(botX - 0.5, bY);
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    // 枕木(横向)
    const tieSpacing = h * 0.025;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#6d4c2a';
    for (let ty = groundTop + (trackOffset % tieSpacing); ty < bY; ty += tieSpacing) {
      const t = (ty - groundTop) / (bY - groundTop);
      const scale = 0.2 + t * 0.8;
      const tieW = railSpread * 1.6 * scale;
      const tieH = h * 0.006 * scale;
      const tieX = lerp(railX1, vX + (railX1 - vX) * ((bY - vX) / (groundTop - vX || 1)), t);
      ctx.fillRect(tieX - tieW / 2, ty, tieW, tieH);
    }
  }

  // ---- 坡道标记(上坡/下坡视觉提示) ----
  if (Math.abs(slopeValue) > 0.05) {
    const arrowY = bY - 20;
    const arrowX = w / 2;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)';
    ctx.font = `${W()*0.03}px Arial`;
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    if (slopeValue > 0.05) {
      ctx.fillText('▲ 上坡', arrowX, arrowY);
    } else if (slopeValue < -0.05) {
      ctx.fillText('▼ 下坡', arrowX, arrowY);
    }
  }
}

// ============================================================
// 渲染: 角色
// ============================================================
function drawCharacter(x, y, scale, state = 'run') {
  // state: 'run', 'jump', 'slide', 'hit'
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x, y);
  ctx.scale(scale, scale);

  const s = W() * 0.032; // 基础尺寸单位
  const isHit = state === 'hit';
  const isSlide = state === 'slide';
  const isJump = state === 'jump';
  const flash = PLAYER.invincible > 0 && Math.floor(PLAYER.invincible * 20) % 2 === 0;

  // ---- 阴影 ----
  if (!isJump) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, s * 1.5, s * 2.5, s * 0.8, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  } else {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.15)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, s * 4, s * 1.5, s * 0.4, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  if (isSlide) {
    // ---- 滑铲姿态 ----
    // 压低的身体
    ctx.fillStyle = flash ? '#fff' : '#2c3e50';
    ctx.fillRect(-s * 2.5, -s * 0.5, s * 5, s * 1.2);
    // 连帽衫颜色
    ctx.fillStyle = flash ? '#fff' : '#e74c3c';
    ctx.fillRect(-s * 2.5, -s * 0.3, s * 3.5, s * 1);
    // 头(压低)
    ctx.fillStyle = flash ? '#fff' : '#f5c6a0';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(-s * 1.8, -s * 0.2, s * 1.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // 帽子
    ctx.fillStyle = flash ? '#fff' : '#e74c3c';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(-s * 1.8, -s * 0.6, s * 1.3, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // 腿(伸展)
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a2e';
    ctx.fillRect(-s * 2.5, s * 0.3, s * 2, s * 0.7);
    ctx.fillRect(s * 1, s * 0.3, s * 1.5, s * 0.7);
    // 鞋
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.fillRect(-s * 2.7, s * 0.8, s * 1.5, s * 0.5);
    ctx.fillRect(s * 1.2, s * 0.8, s * 1.3, s * 0.5);
  } else {
    // ---- 正常/跳跃/跑步姿态 ----
    const bodySquash = isJump ? -0.7 : 0;
    const bodyY = -s * 2 + bodySquash;

    // 跑步动画计算
    const runCycle = frameCount * 0.15;
    const armSwingL = Math.sin(runCycle) * s * 1.5;
    const armSwingR = Math.sin(runCycle + Math.PI) * s * 1.5;
    const legSwingL = Math.sin(runCycle) * s * 1.8;
    const legSwingR = Math.sin(runCycle + Math.PI) * s * 1.8;
    const bodyBob = Math.abs(Math.sin(runCycle * 2)) * s * 0.3;

    const realBodyY = bodyY - bodyBob;

    // 左腿
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a2e';
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(-s * 0.8, realBodyY + s * 2.5);
    ctx.rotate(legSwingL * 0.08);
    ctx.fillRect(-s * 0.5, 0, s, s * 2.5);
    // 鞋
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.fillRect(-s * 0.6, s * 2.2, s * 1.2, s * 0.6);
    ctx.restore();

    // 右腿
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a2e';
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(s * 0.8, realBodyY + s * 2.5);
    ctx.rotate(legSwingR * 0.08);
    ctx.fillRect(-s * 0.5, 0, s, s * 2.5);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.fillRect(-s * 0.6, s * 2.2, s * 1.2, s * 0.6);
    ctx.restore();

    // 身体(躯干)
    ctx.fillStyle = flash ? '#fff' : '#2c3e50';
    ctx.fillRect(-s * 1.5, realBodyY, s * 3, s * 3);
    // 连帽衫(上半身)
    ctx.fillStyle = flash ? '#fff' : '#e74c3c';
    ctx.fillRect(-s * 1.8, realBodyY, s * 3.6, s * 2);
    // 帽衫下摆
    ctx.fillStyle = flash ? '#fff' : '#c0392b';
    ctx.fillRect(-s * 1.6, realBodyY + s * 1.8, s * 3.2, s * 1.2);

    // 左臂
    ctx.fillStyle = flash ? '#fff' : '#e74c3c';
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(-s * 1.8, realBodyY + s * 0.5);
    ctx.rotate(-0.3 + armSwingL * 0.06);
    ctx.fillRect(-s * 0.4, 0, s * 0.8, s * 2.2);
    // 手
    ctx.fillStyle = flash ? '#fff' : '#f5c6a0';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, s * 2.3, s * 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();

    // 右臂
    ctx.fillStyle = flash ? '#fff' : '#e74c3c';
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(s * 1.8, realBodyY + s * 0.5);
    ctx.rotate(0.3 + armSwingR * 0.06);
    ctx.fillRect(-s * 0.4, 0, s * 0.8, s * 2.2);
    ctx.fillStyle = flash ? '#fff' : '#f5c6a0';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, s * 2.3, s * 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();

    // 头
    const headY = realBodyY - s * 1.5;
    ctx.fillStyle = flash ? '#fff' : '#f5c6a0';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, headY, s * 1.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // 帽子
    ctx.fillStyle = flash ? '#fff' : '#e74c3c';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, headY - s * 0.3, s * 1.4, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // 帽檐
    ctx.fillStyle = flash ? '#fff' : '#c0392b';
    ctx.fillRect(-s * 1.6, headY - s * 0.3, s * 3.2, s * 0.3);
    // 帽子前沿
    ctx.fillStyle = flash ? '#fff' : '#e74c3c';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-s * 1.8, headY - s * 0.3);
    ctx.lineTo(s * 1.8, headY - s * 0.3);
    ctx.lineTo(s * 1.3, headY - s * 0.9);
    ctx.lineTo(-s * 1.3, headY - s * 0.9);
    ctx.fill();

    // 头发(从帽子下露出)
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a1a';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, headY + s * 0.8, s * 1.1, -0.2, Math.PI + 0.2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // ---- 滑板特效 ----
  if (PLAYER.skateboard && PLAYER.skateboardTimer > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(46,204,113,0.4)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, s * 1, s * 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2ecc71';
    ctx.fillRect(-s * 3, s * 1.4, s * 6, s * 0.4);
    ctx.fillRect(-s * 2.2, s * 1.6, s * 1, s * 0.3);
    ctx.fillRect(s * 1.2, s * 1.6, s * 1, s * 0.3);
  }

  // ---- 磁铁特效 ----
  if (PLAYER.magnetActive && PLAYER.magnetTimer > 0) {
    const pulse = Math.sin(frameCount * 0.3) * 0.3 + 0.5;
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(52,152,219,${pulse})`;
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, s * 0.5, s * 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(52,152,219,${pulse*0.5})`;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, s * 0.5, s * 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  ctx.restore();
}

// ============================================================
// 渲染: 障碍物
// ============================================================
function drawObstacle(obs) {
  const pw = PERSPECTIVE;
  const laneW = W() * 0.12 * pw.scaleAt(obs.screenY) * 3;
  const sx = W() * 0.5 + obs.lane * laneW;
  const sy = obs.screenY;
  const sc = pw.scaleAt(sy);
  const s = W() * 0.03 * sc;

  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(sx, sy);

  switch (obs.type) {
    case 'barrier':
      // 道口栏杆 - 横杆+柱子
      ctx.fillStyle = '#e74c3c';
      ctx.fillRect(-s * 5, -s * 0.8, s * 10, s * 1.6);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.fillRect(-s * 4.5, -s * 0.4, s * 2, s * 0.8);
      ctx.fillRect(s * 1.5, -s * 0.4, s * 2, s * 0.8);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
      ctx.fillRect(-s * 4, s * 0.8, s * 0.5, s * 3);
      ctx.fillRect(s * 3.5, s * 0.8, s * 0.5, s * 3);
      break;
    case 'pipe':
      // 横放铁管
      ctx.fillStyle = '#95a5a6';
      ctx.fillRect(-s * 4.5, -s * 0.6, s * 9, s * 1.2);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#7f8c8d';
      ctx.fillRect(-s * 4.5, -s * 0.6, s * 9, s * 0.3);
      break;
    case 'fence':
      // 低矮围栏
      ctx.fillStyle = '#f39c12';
      for (let fx = -s * 4; fx <= s * 4; fx += s * 1.2) {
        ctx.fillRect(fx, -s * 2, s * 0.3, s * 2);
      }
      ctx.fillRect(-s * 4.2, -s * 1.8, s * 8.4, s * 0.4);
      ctx.fillRect(-s * 4.2, -s * 0.8, s * 8.4, s * 0.4);
      break;
    case 'signalBox':
      // 信号灯箱
      ctx.fillStyle = '#2c3e50';
      ctx.fillRect(-s * 1.5, -s * 4, s * 3, s * 4);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#e74c3c';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, -s * 2.5, s, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#2ecc71';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, -s * 1, s, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      // 闪烁
      if (Math.sin(frameCount * 0.2) > 0) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0000';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(0, -s * 2.5, s * 0.7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }
      ctx.fillStyle = '#555';
      ctx.fillRect(-s * 0.3, -s * 0.2, s * 0.6, s * 3);
      break;
    case 'tiesPile':
      // 枕木堆
      ctx.fillStyle = '#8B4513';
      for (let tx = -s * 2.5; tx <= s * 2.5; tx += s * 1.5) {
        ctx.fillRect(tx, -s * (1.5 + Math.random() * 0.8), s * 1.4, s * 0.6);
      }
      ctx.fillRect(-s * 2.8, -s * 1, s * 5.6, s * 0.6);
      ctx.fillRect(-s * 2.2, -s * 1.8, s * 4.4, s * 0.6);
      break;
    case 'cone':
      // 施工锥桶
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6600';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, -s * 3);
      ctx.lineTo(-s * 1.5, s * 0.5);
      ctx.lineTo(s * 1.5, s * 0.5);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.fillRect(-s * 0.8, -s * 1.8, s * 1.6, s * 0.4);
      ctx.fillRect(-s * 0.6, -s * 0.6, s * 1.2, s * 0.4);
      break;
    case 'maintCart':
      // 维修车
      ctx.fillStyle = '#f1c40f';
      ctx.fillRect(-s * 3, -s * 2.5, s * 6, s * 3.5);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#e67e22';
      ctx.fillRect(-s * 2.5, -s * 2, s * 5, s * 2.5);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(-s * 2, s * 1.5, s * 0.8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(s * 2, s * 1.5, s * 0.8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      break;
    case 'tower':
      // 信号塔基座
      ctx.fillStyle = '#7f8c8d';
      ctx.fillRect(-s * 2.5, -s * 5, s * 5, s * 5.5);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#666';
      for (let ty = -s * 4.5; ty < s * 0.5; ty += s * 1.2) {
        ctx.fillRect(-s * 3, ty, s * 6, s * 0.3);
      }
      break;
    case 'worker':
      // 横穿工人(动态移动)
      const wx = Math.sin(frameCount * 0.05 + obs.wobble) * s * 3;
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6600';
      ctx.fillRect(wx - s, -s * 3.5, s * 2, s * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a2e';
      ctx.fillRect(wx - s, -s * 1.5, s * 2, s * 2.5);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#f5c6a0';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(wx, -s * 4, s, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#f39c12';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(wx, -s * 4.2, s * 1.2, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      break;
  }

  // 警告指示 (离玩家很近时)
  const playerScreenY = H() * PLAYER.y;
  if (sy > playerScreenY - H() * 0.05 && sy < playerScreenY + H() * 0.03 && !obs.passed) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,0,0,0.3)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, -s * 3, s * 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  ctx.restore();
}

// ============================================================
// 渲染: 火车
// ============================================================
function drawTrain(train) {
  const pw = PERSPECTIVE;
  const laneW = W() * 0.12 * pw.scaleAt(train.screenY) * 3;
  const sx = W() * 0.5 + train.lane * laneW;
  const sy = train.screenY;
  const sc = pw.scaleAt(sy);
  const s = W() * 0.03 * sc;

  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(sx, sy);

  // 火车头
  const headX = train.numCars * s * 4;
  ctx.fillStyle = train.color;
  ctx.fillRect(headX - s * 2, -s * 5, s * 4.5, s * 6);
  // 驾驶室窗
  ctx.fillStyle = '#87CEEB';
  ctx.fillRect(headX - s, -s * 4, s * 2.5, s * 2);
  // 车灯
  if (train.lightOn) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffff00';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(headX + s * 1.8, -s * 2, s * 0.8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // 光晕
    const glowGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(headX + s * 1.8, -s * 2, s * 0.3, headX + s * 1.8, -s * 2, s * 2);
    glowGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,100,0.6)');
    glowGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,0,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = glowGrad;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(headX + s * 1.8, -s * 2, s * 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  // 烟囱
  ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
  ctx.fillRect(headX - s * 0.5, -s * 6.5, s * 1.2, s * 1.8);

  // 车厢
  for (let c = 0; c < train.numCars; c++) {
    const cx = c * s * 4.5;
    ctx.fillStyle = train.color;
    ctx.fillRect(cx, -s * 4.5, s * 4.2, s * 5.5);
    // 车厢分隔线
    ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
    ctx.fillRect(cx + s * 4, -s * 4.5, s * 0.2, s * 5.5);
    // 车轮
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a1a';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx + s * 1, s * 1.5, s * 0.7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx + s * 3, s * 1.5, s * 0.7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // 涂鸦
    if ((c + train.graffiti) % 2 === 0) {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.font = `${s*1.5}px Arial`;
      ctx.fillText('WILD', cx + s * 0.3, -s * 2.5);
    } else if ((c + train.graffiti) % 3 === 0) {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
      ctx.font = `bold ${s*1.3}px Arial`;
      ctx.fillText('ART', cx + s * 0.5, -s * 1.5);
    }
  }

  // 可攀爬标记(车顶平台)
  if (train.climbable) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(100,200,100,0.5)';
    ctx.fillRect(-s, -s * 5.2, train.numCars * s * 4.7, s * 0.8);
  }

  // 火车名(涂鸦风格)
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = `bold ${s*1}px Arial`;
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('METRO', headX, -s * 3);

  ctx.restore();
}

// ============================================================
// 渲染: 道具
// ============================================================
function drawPowerup(pu) {
  const pw = PERSPECTIVE;
  const laneW = W() * 0.12 * pw.scaleAt(pu.screenY) * 3;
  const sx = W() * 0.5 + pu.lane * laneW;
  const sy = pu.screenY;
  const sc = pw.scaleAt(sy);
  const s = W() * 0.03 * sc;

  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(sx, sy);
  ctx.rotate(sy * 2 + pu.rotation); // 旋转效果
  const bob = Math.sin(frameCount * 0.08 + pu.bobOffset) * s * 0.5;
  ctx.translate(0, bob);

  switch (pu.type) {
    case 'coin':
      // 金币
      ctx.fillStyle = '#f1c40f';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, 0, s * 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#f39c12';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, 0, s * 1.1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#f1c40f';
      ctx.font = `bold ${s*1.8}px Arial`;
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
      ctx.fillText('$', 0, 0);
      break;
    case 'coinSilver':
      // 银币
      ctx.fillStyle = '#bdc3c7';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, 0, s * 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ecf0f1';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, 0, s * 1.1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#95a5a6';
      ctx.font = `bold ${s*1.8}px Arial`;
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
      ctx.fillText('$', 0, 0);
      break;
    case 'medkit':
      // 医疗包 - 白色方块+红十字
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.fillRect(-s * 1.8, -s * 1.8, s * 3.6, s * 3.6);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#e74c3c';
      ctx.fillRect(-s * 0.4, -s * 1.3, s * 0.8, s * 2.6);
      ctx.fillRect(-s * 1.3, -s * 0.4, s * 2.6, s * 0.8);
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#c0392b';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.strokeRect(-s * 1.8, -s * 1.8, s * 3.6, s * 3.6);
      break;
    case 'magnet':
      // 磁铁 - 蓝色U形
      ctx.fillStyle = '#3498db';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, s * 0.2, s * 2, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.lineWidth = s * 0.8;
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#3498db';
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#e74c3c';
      ctx.fillRect(-s * 1.8, -s * 0.3, s * 0.8, s * 1);
      ctx.fillRect(s * 1, -s * 0.3, s * 0.8, s * 1);
      break;
    case 'doubleCoin':
      // 双倍金币 - 金色星星
      ctx.fillStyle = '#f39c12';
      drawStar(0, 0, s * 1.8, s * 0.7, 5);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#f1c40f';
      drawStar(0, 0, s * 1.2, s * 0.45, 5);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.font = `bold ${s*1.2}px Arial`;
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
      ctx.fillText('x2', 0, 0);
      break;
    case 'skateboard':
      // 滑板 - 绿色
      ctx.fillStyle = '#2ecc71';
      ctx.fillRect(-s * 2.5, -s * 0.5, s * 5, s * 1);
      ctx.fillRect(-s * 2, s * 0.3, s * 1, s * 0.6);
      ctx.fillRect(s * 1, s * 0.3, s * 1, s * 0.6);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#27ae60';
      ctx.font = `bold ${s*1}px Arial`;
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
      ctx.fillText('SK8', 0, 0);
      break;
  }

  ctx.restore();
}

function drawStar(cx, cy, outerR, innerR, points) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  for (let i = 0; i < points * 2; i++) {
    const r = i % 2 === 0 ? outerR : innerR;
    const angle = (i * Math.PI) / points - Math.PI / 2;
    const x = cx + Math.cos(angle) * r;
    const y = cy + Math.sin(angle) * r;
    if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
    else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
  }
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
}

// ============================================================
// 渲染: 粒子
// ============================================================
function drawParticles() {
  for (const p of particles) {
    const alpha = p.life / p.maxLife;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color.replace(')', `,${alpha})`).replace('rgb', 'rgba');
    if (p.color.startsWith('#')) {
      const r = parseInt(p.color.slice(1, 3), 16);
      const g = parseInt(p.color.slice(3, 5), 16);
      const b = parseInt(p.color.slice(5, 7), 16);
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${r},${g},${b},${alpha})`;
    }
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * alpha, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawHeart(x, y, size) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  const topY = y - size * 0.8;
  ctx.moveTo(x, topY + size * 1.5);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(x, topY + size * 0.5, x - size, topY, x - size * 0.5, topY + size * 0.2);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(x - size * 0.5, topY + size * 0.8, x, topY + size * 1.2, x, topY + size * 1.8);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(x, topY + size * 1.2, x + size * 0.5, topY + size * 0.8, x + size * 0.5, topY + size * 0.2);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(x + size, topY, x, topY + size * 0.5, x, topY + size * 1.5);
  ctx.fill();
}

function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.lineTo(x + w - r, y);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r);
  ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h);
  ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + h);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r);
  ctx.lineTo(x, y + r);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y);
  ctx.closePath();
}

// ============================================================
// 输入处理
// ============================================================
function handleInput(action) {
  if (gameState === STATE.MENU) {
    if (action === 'start' || action === 'jump' || action === 'slide') {
      startGame();
    }
    return;
  }
  if (gameState === STATE.DEAD) {
    if (action === 'start' || action === 'jump' || action === 'slide') {
      startGame();
    }
    return;
  }
  if (gameState !== STATE.PLAYING) return;

  switch (action) {
    case 'left':
      PLAYER.targetLane = Math.max(-1, PLAYER.targetLane - 1);
      break;
    case 'right':
      PLAYER.targetLane = Math.min(1, PLAYER.targetLane + 1);
      break;
    case 'jump':
      if (!PLAYER.isJumping && !PLAYER.isSliding) {
        PLAYER.isJumping = true;
        PLAYER.vy = -9;
        PLAYER.jumpHeight = 0;
        sfxJump();
      }
      break;
    case 'slide':
      if (!PLAYER.isJumping && !PLAYER.isSliding) {
        PLAYER.isSliding = true;
        PLAYER.slideTimer = 0.55;
        sfxSlide();
      }
      break;
  }
}

// 键盘
const keys = {};
window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  if (keys[e.code]) return;
  keys[e.code] = true;
  switch (e.code) {
    case 'ArrowLeft': case 'KeyA': handleInput('left'); break;
    case 'ArrowRight': case 'KeyD': handleInput('right'); break;
    case 'ArrowUp': case 'KeyW': handleInput('jump'); break;
    case 'ArrowDown': case 'KeyS': handleInput('slide'); break;
    case 'Space': handleInput('start'); break;
  }
  e.preventDefault();
});
window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.code] = false; });

// 触屏
let touchStartX = 0, touchStartY = 0, touchStartTime = 0;
window.addEventListener('touchstart', e => {
  const t = e.touches[0];
  touchStartX = t.clientX;
  touchStartY = t.clientY;
  touchStartTime = Date.now();
});
window.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
  const t = e.changedTouches[0];
  const dx = t.clientX - touchStartX;
  const dy = t.clientY - touchStartY;
  const dt = Date.now() - touchStartTime;

  if (Math.abs(dx) < 10 && Math.abs(dy) < 10 && dt < 300) {
    // Tap
    handleInput('start');
    return;
  }
  if (Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy) && Math.abs(dx) > 30) {
    handleInput(dx > 0 ? 'right' : 'left');
  } else if (Math.abs(dy) > 30) {
    handleInput(dy < 0 ? 'jump' : 'slide');
  }
});

// 点击(PC)
canvas.addEventListener('click', e => {
  if (gameState !== STATE.PLAYING) {
    handleInput('start');
  }
});

// ============================================================
// 游戏更新
// ============================================================
function update(dt) {
  if (gameState !== STATE.PLAYING) return;
  if (slowMotion > 0) {
    dt *= 0.3;
    slowMotion -= dt;
  }

  // 限制最大步长
  dt = Math.min(dt, 0.1);
  frameCount++;

  // ---- 速度 & 坡度 ----
  slopeTimer -= dt;
  if (slopeTimer <= 0) {
    targetSlope = rand(-0.6, 0.6);
    slopeTimer = rand(3, 7);
  }
  slopeValue = lerp(slopeValue, targetSlope, dt * 0.5);
  currentSpeed = speed * (1 - slopeValue * 0.25); // 上坡慢，下坡快
  currentSpeed = Math.max(150, Math.min(450, currentSpeed));

  // ---- 距离 & 分数 ----
  const distDelta = currentSpeed * dt;
  totalDistanceTraveled += distDelta;
  distance += distDelta;
  score += distDelta * 0.5;
  trackOffset += distDelta * 0.8;
  sceneOffset += distDelta * 0.3;

  // 每500米回血
  if (totalDistanceTraveled - lastHealDistance >= 500) {
    lastHealDistance = Math.floor(totalDistanceTraveled / 500) * 500;
    if (PLAYER.hp < PLAYER.maxHp) {
      PLAYER.hp = Math.min(PLAYER.maxHp, PLAYER.hp + 1);
      sfxHeal();
      spawnParticles(W() / 2, H() * PLAYER.y, 12, '#e74c3c');
    }
  }

  // ---- 跑道切换平滑过渡 ----
  PLAYER.lane = PLAYER.targetLane;
  PLAYER.currentLaneX = lerp(PLAYER.currentLaneX, PLAYER.lane, dt * 10);

  // ---- 跳跃 ----
  if (PLAYER.isJumping) {
    PLAYER.jumpHeight += PLAYER.vy * dt;
    PLAYER.vy += 25 * dt; // 重力
    if (PLAYER.jumpHeight >= 0) {
      PLAYER.jumpHeight = 0;
      PLAYER.vy = 0;
      PLAYER.isJumping = false;
    }
  }

  // ---- 滑铲 ----
  if (PLAYER.isSliding) {
    PLAYER.slideTimer -= dt;
    if (PLAYER.slideTimer <= 0) {
      PLAYER.isSliding = false;
    }
  }

  // ---- 无敌时间 ----
  if (PLAYER.invincible > 0) PLAYER.invincible -= dt;

  // ---- 道具计时器 ----
  if (PLAYER.magnetTimer > 0) { PLAYER.magnetTimer -= dt; if (PLAYER.magnetTimer <= 0) PLAYER.magnetActive = false; }
  if (PLAYER.doubleCoinTimer > 0) { PLAYER.doubleCoinTimer -= dt; if (PLAYER.doubleCoinTimer <= 0) PLAYER.doubleCoin = false; }
  if (PLAYER.skateboardTimer > 0) { PLAYER.skateboardTimer -= dt; if (PLAYER.skateboardTimer <= 0) PLAYER.skateboard = false; }

  // ---- 火车顶跟随 ----
  if (PLAYER.onTrain) {
    PLAYER.trainRideX += currentSpeed * dt * 0.8;
    // 检查火车是否快出屏幕
    const t = PLAYER.onTrain;
    if (t.screenY > H() * 0.85) {
      // 强制跳回轨道
      PLAYER.onTrain = null;
      PLAYER.isJumping = true;
      PLAYER.vy = -8;
      PLAYER.jumpHeight = -H() * 0.02;
    }
  }

  // ---- 更新障碍物 ----
  for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const o = obstacles[i];
    const pw = PERSPECTIVE;
    o.worldY += currentSpeed * dt / (H() * 0.8); // 向玩家移动
    o.screenY = H() * pw.vanishY + o.worldY * (H() * pw.groundBase - H() * pw.vanishY);

    // 移除出屏的
    if (o.worldY > 1.1) {
      if (!o.passed) {
        // 安全通过，加分
        score += 10;
      }
      obstacles.splice(i, 1);
      continue;
    }

    // 碰撞检测
    if (!o.passed && o.worldY > 0.65 && o.worldY < 0.9) {
      if (Math.abs(PLAYER.currentLaneX - o.lane) < 0.4) {
        // 同跑道
        let hit = true;
        // 跳跃可以越过高度为1的障碍
        if (PLAYER.isJumping && PLAYER.jumpHeight < -H() * 0.04 && o.action === 1) hit = false;
        // 滑铲可以越过高度为0的障碍
        if (PLAYER.isSliding && o.action === 0) hit = false;
        // 高度为2的障碍(换道)在非本跑道时不会碰到
        if (o.action === 2 && Math.abs(PLAYER.currentLaneX - o.lane) > 0.3) hit = false;

        if (hit && PLAYER.invincible <= 0) {
          // 碰到! 扣血
          if (PLAYER.skateboard) {
            // 滑板免疫一次
            PLAYER.skateboard = false;
            PLAYER.skateboardTimer = 0;
            spawnParticles(W() / 2, H() * PLAYER.y, 15, '#2ecc71');
          } else {
            PLAYER.hp--;
            PLAYER.invincible = 1.5;
            sfxHit();
            shakeIntensity = 5;
            shakeTimer = 0.3;
            spawnParticles(W() / 2, H() * PLAYER.y, 10, '#ff0000');
            if (PLAYER.hp <= 0) {
              gameOver();
              return;
            }
          }
        }
        // 标记已通过，避免重复碰撞
        if (o.worldY > 0.78) o.passed = true;
      }
    }
  }

  // ---- 更新道具 ----
  for (let i = powerups.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = powerups[i];
    const pw = PERSPECTIVE;
    p.worldY += currentSpeed * dt / (H() * 0.8);
    p.screenY = H() * pw.vanishY + p.worldY * (H() * pw.groundBase - H() * pw.vanishY);
    p.rotation += dt * 3;

    // 磁铁吸引
    if (PLAYER.magnetActive && p.worldY > 0.4 && p.worldY < 0.85) {
      const playerLane = PLAYER.currentLaneX;
      p.lane = lerp(p.lane, playerLane, dt * 2);
    }

    if (p.worldY > 1.05) {
      powerups.splice(i, 1);
      continue;
    }

    // 收集检测
    if (p.worldY > 0.65 && p.worldY < 0.88 && Math.abs(PLAYER.currentLaneX - p.lane) < 0.5) {
      collectPowerup(p);
      powerups.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  // ---- 更新火车 ----
  for (let i = trains.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const t = trains[i];
    const pw = PERSPECTIVE;
    t.worldY += currentSpeed * dt / (H() * 0.8);
    t.screenY = H() * pw.vanishY + t.worldY * (H() * pw.groundBase - H() * pw.vanishY);
    t.lightTimer += dt;
    t.lightOn = Math.sin(t.lightTimer * 5) > 0;
    t.hornTimer -= dt;
    if (t.hornTimer <= 0 && t.worldY > 0.1 && t.worldY < 0.8) {
      sfxTrainHorn();
      t.hornTimer = rand(2, 4);
    }

    if (t.worldY > 1.15) {
      if (PLAYER.onTrain === t) PLAYER.onTrain = null;
      trains.splice(i, 1);
      continue;
    }

    // 火车碰撞
    if (t.worldY > 0.65 && t.worldY < 0.9) {
      if (Math.abs(PLAYER.currentLaneX - t.lane) < 0.4 && !PLAYER.isJumping && PLAYER.onTrain !== t) {
        // 可攀爬火车(从高架跳上)
        if (t.climbable && PLAYER.isJumping && PLAYER.jumpHeight < -H() * 0.05 && slopeValue > 0.2) {

// ============================================================
// 游戏流程
// ============================================================
function startGame() {
  initAudio();
  resetPlayer();
  obstacles = [];
  powerups = [];
  trains = [];
  particles = [];
  sceneryItems = [];
  score = 0;
  distance = 0;
  totalDistanceTraveled = 0;
  lastHealDistance = 0;
  speed = 280;         // 基础速度(像素/秒 等效)
  currentSpeed = 280;
  slopeValue = 0;
  targetSlope = 0;
  slopeTimer = 0;
  spawnTimer = 0;
  powerupSpawnTimer = 0;
  trainSpawnTimer = 0;
  nextTrainTime = 6 + rand(0, 4);
  sceneOffset = 0;
  trackOffset = 0;
  shakeTimer = 0;
  shakeIntensity = 0;
  slowMotion = 0;
  gameState = STATE.PLAYING;

  // 生成初始远景色
  generateScenery();
}

function generateScenery() {
  sceneryItems = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
    sceneryItems.push({
      x: rand(0.05, 0.95),
      y: rand(0.05, 0.25),
      size: rand(15, 45),
      type: randInt(0, 2), // 0=建筑, 1=树, 2=起重机
      color: `hsl(${randInt(190, 260)}, ${randInt(20, 50)}%, ${randInt(20, 50)}%)`,
    });
  }
}

function gameOver() {
  gameState = STATE.DEAD;
  sfxDeath();
  shakeIntensity = 8;
  shakeTimer = 0.4;
  slowMotion = 0.6;
  if (score > highScore) {
    highScore = score;
    localStorage.setItem('subwayHighScore', highScore);
  }
}

// ============================================================
// 渲染: 天空 & 城市背景
// ============================================================
function drawSky() {
  const h = H();
  const vY = h * PERSPECTIVE.vanishY;
  // 天空渐变: 顶部深蓝 -> 消失点浅蓝
  const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, vY);
  grad.addColorStop(0, '#1a1a4e');
  grad.addColorStop(0.4, '#2d3a7a');
  grad.addColorStop(0.7, '#5b8cbe');
  grad.addColorStop(1, '#a8d8ea');
  ctx.fillStyle = grad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W(), vY);

  // 太阳/光晕
  const sunX = W() * 0.75 + sceneOffset * 0.03;
  const sunY = h * 0.05;
  const sunGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(sunX, sunY, W() * 0.02, sunX, sunY, W() * 0.12);
  sunGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,200,0.9)');
  sunGrad.addColorStop(0.3, 'rgba(255,200,150,0.4)');
  sunGrad.addColorStop(0.7, 'rgba(255,150,100,0.1)');
  sunGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,100,50,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = sunGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W(), vY);
}

function drawCitySkyline() {
  const h = H();
  const vY = h * PERSPECTIVE.vanishY;
  const w = W();

  // 远距离建筑(小，缓慢视差)
  for (const s of sceneryItems) {
    if (s.y > vY / h) continue;
    const sy = s.y * h;
    const sx = (s.x * w + sceneOffset * 0.02 * (1 - s.y * 3)) % w;
    const sz = s.size * (0.5 + s.y * 1.5);

    ctx.fillStyle = s.color;
    if (s.type === 0) {
      // 建筑
      ctx.fillRect(sx - sz * 0.3, sy - sz, sz * 0.6, sz);
      // 窗户
      const winColor = 'rgba(255,255,200,0.6)';
      ctx.fillStyle = winColor;
      for (let wy = sy - sz + sz * 0.1; wy < sy; wy += sz * 0.2) {
        for (let wx = sx - sz * 0.2; wx < sx + sz * 0.2; wx += sz * 0.15) {
          if (Math.random() > 0.4) ctx.fillRect(wx, wy, sz * 0.06, sz * 0.08);
        }
      }
    } else if (s.type === 1) {
      // 简化的树
      ctx.fillStyle = '#2d5016';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(sx, sy - sz * 0.6, sz * 0.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#4a3520';
      ctx.fillRect(sx - sz * 0.04, sy - sz * 0.3, sz * 0.08, sz * 0.3);
    } else {
      // 起重机
      ctx.strokeStyle = s.color;
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(sx, sy);
      ctx.lineTo(sx, sy - sz);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(sx - sz * 0.3, sy - sz * 0.7);
      ctx.lineTo(sx, sy - sz);
      ctx.lineTo(sx + sz * 0.4, sy - sz * 0.4);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }
}

// ============================================================
// 渲染: 地形 (轨道、枕木、碎石、高架桥墩)
// ============================================================
function drawTerrain() {
  const h = H();
  const w = W();
  const vY = h * PERSPECTIVE.vanishY;
  const bY = h * PERSPECTIVE.groundBase;
  const vX = w * PERSPECTIVE.vanishX;
  const slopeOffset = slopeValue * h * 0.12; // 坡度对消失点的偏移

  // 地面区域
  const groundTop = vY + slopeOffset;

  // ---- 碎石地面 ----
  const groundGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, groundTop, 0, bY);
  groundGrad.addColorStop(0, '#8a8a7a');
  groundGrad.addColorStop(0.3, '#9e9e8e');
  groundGrad.addColorStop(0.7, '#7a7a6a');
  groundGrad.addColorStop(1, '#5a5a4a');
  ctx.fillStyle = groundGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, groundTop, w, bY - groundTop);

  // 碎石纹理
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(180,175,160,0.3)';
  const gravelStep = h * 0.015;
  for (let gy = groundTop + (trackOffset % gravelStep); gy < bY; gy += gravelStep) {
    for (let gx = 0; gx < w; gx += gravelStep * 1.5) {
      if (Math.random() > 0.65) {
        const gs = gravelStep * 0.3 * ((gy - groundTop) / (bY - groundTop));
        ctx.fillRect(gx, gy, gs, gs);
      }
    }
  }

  // ---- 高架桥墩 ----
  if (slopeValue > 0.15) {
    const pierCount = 4;
    const pierSpacing = w / pierCount;
    for (let px = pierSpacing * 0.3; px < w; px += pierSpacing) {
      const pierH = slopeValue * h * 0.2;
      const pierTop = groundTop;
      const pierBot = groundTop + pierH;
      const pierW = w * 0.015;

      ctx.fillStyle = '#5a5a5a';
      ctx.fillRect(px - pierW, pierTop, pierW * 2, pierH);

      // 横梁
      ctx.fillStyle = '#4a4a4a';
      ctx.fillRect(px - pierW * 2, pierTop, pierW * 4, pierW * 1.5);
      ctx.fillRect(px - pierW * 1.5, pierBot - pierW, pierW * 3, pierW);
    }
  }

  // ---- 三条铁轨 ----
  const lanes = [-1, 0, 1];
  for (const lane of lanes) {
    // 铁轨透视: 从消失点辐射
    const railSpread = w * 0.06;
    const railX1 = vX + lane * railSpread * 3;
    const railX2 = railX1 + railSpread;

    // 每条轨道的两根钢轨
    for (const offset of [0, 1]) {
      const rx = offset === 0 ? railX1 : railX2;
      const railBottomX = vX + (rx - vX) * (bY - groundTop) / (bY - groundTop) * (bY / h);

      // 绘制钢轨(近处粗远处细)
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#7f8c8d';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(rx, groundTop);
      // 计算底部X(透视发散)
      const dx = rx - vX;
      const botX = vX + dx * ((bY - vX) / (groundTop - vX || 1));
      ctx.lineTo(botX, bY);
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
      ctx.stroke();

      // 轨顶高光
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#bdc3c7';
      ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(rx - 0.5, groundTop);
      ctx.lineTo(botX - 0.5, bY);
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    // 枕木(横向)
    const tieSpacing = h * 0.025;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#6d4c2a';
    for (let ty = groundTop + (trackOffset % tieSpacing); ty < bY; ty += tieSpacing) {
      const t = (ty - groundTop) / (bY - groundTop);
      const scale = 0.2 + t * 0.8;
      const tieW = railSpread * 1.6 * scale;
      const tieH = h * 0.006 * scale;
      const tieX = lerp(railX1, vX + (railX1 - vX) * ((bY - vX) / (groundTop - vX || 1)), t);
      ctx.fillRect(tieX - tieW / 2, ty, tieW, tieH);
    }
  }

  // ---- 坡道标记(上坡/下坡视觉提示) ----
  if (Math.abs(slopeValue) > 0.05) {
    const arrowY = bY - 20;
    const arrowX = w / 2;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)';
    ctx.font = `${W()*0.03}px Arial`;
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    if (slopeValue > 0.05) {
      ctx.fillText('▲ 上坡', arrowX, arrowY);
    } else if (slopeValue < -0.05) {
      ctx.fillText('▼ 下坡', arrowX, arrowY);
    }
  }
}

// ============================================================
// 渲染: 角色
// ============================================================
function drawCharacter(x, y, scale, state = 'run') {
  // state: 'run', 'jump', 'slide', 'hit'
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x, y);
  ctx.scale(scale, scale);

  const s = W() * 0.032; // 基础尺寸单位
  const isHit = state === 'hit';
  const isSlide = state === 'slide';
  const isJump = state === 'jump';
  const flash = PLAYER.invincible > 0 && Math.floor(PLAYER.invincible * 20) % 2 === 0;

  // ---- 阴影 ----
  if (!isJump) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, s * 1.5, s * 2.5, s * 0.8, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  } else {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.15)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, s * 4, s * 1.5, s * 0.4, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  if (isSlide) {
    // ---- 滑铲姿态 ----
    // 压低的身体
    ctx.fillStyle = flash ? '#fff' : '#2c3e50';
    ctx.fillRect(-s * 2.5, -s * 0.5, s * 5, s * 1.2);
    // 连帽衫颜色
    ctx.fillStyle = flash ? '#fff' : '#e74c3c';
    ctx.fillRect(-s * 2.5, -s * 0.3, s * 3.5, s * 1);
    // 头(压低)
    ctx.fillStyle = flash ? '#fff' : '#f5c6a0';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(-s * 1.8, -s * 0.2, s * 1.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // 帽子
    ctx.fillStyle = flash ? '#fff' : '#e74c3c';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(-s * 1.8, -s * 0.6, s * 1.3, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // 腿(伸展)
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a2e';
    ctx.fillRect(-s * 2.5, s * 0.3, s * 2, s * 0.7);
    ctx.fillRect(s * 1, s * 0.3, s * 1.5, s * 0.7);
    // 鞋
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.fillRect(-s * 2.7, s * 0.8, s * 1.5, s * 0.5);
    ctx.fillRect(s * 1.2, s * 0.8, s * 1.3, s * 0.5);
  } else {
    // ---- 正常/跳跃/跑步姿态 ----
    const bodySquash = isJump ? -0.7 : 0;
    const bodyY = -s * 2 + bodySquash;

    // 跑步动画计算
    const runCycle = frameCount * 0.15;
    const armSwingL = Math.sin(runCycle) * s * 1.5;
    const armSwingR = Math.sin(runCycle + Math.PI) * s * 1.5;
    const legSwingL = Math.sin(runCycle) * s * 1.8;
    const legSwingR = Math.sin(runCycle + Math.PI) * s * 1.8;
    const bodyBob = Math.abs(Math.sin(runCycle * 2)) * s * 0.3;

    const realBodyY = bodyY - bodyBob;

    // 左腿
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a2e';
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(-s * 0.8, realBodyY + s * 2.5);
    ctx.rotate(legSwingL * 0.08);
    ctx.fillRect(-s * 0.5, 0, s, s * 2.5);
    // 鞋
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.fillRect(-s * 0.6, s * 2.2, s * 1.2, s * 0.6);
    ctx.restore();

    // 右腿
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a2e';
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(s * 0.8, realBodyY + s * 2.5);
    ctx.rotate(legSwingR * 0.08);
    ctx.fillRect(-s * 0.5, 0, s, s * 2.5);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.fillRect(-s * 0.6, s * 2.2, s * 1.2, s * 0.6);
    ctx.restore();

    // 身体(躯干)
    ctx.fillStyle = flash ? '#fff' : '#2c3e50';
    ctx.fillRect(-s * 1.5, realBodyY, s * 3, s * 3);
    // 连帽衫(上半身)
    ctx.fillStyle = flash ? '#fff' : '#e74c3c';
    ctx.fillRect(-s * 1.8, realBodyY, s * 3.6, s * 2);
    // 帽衫下摆
    ctx.fillStyle = flash ? '#fff' : '#c0392b';
    ctx.fillRect(-s * 1.6, realBodyY + s * 1.8, s * 3.2, s * 1.2);

    // 左臂
    ctx.fillStyle = flash ? '#fff' : '#e74c3c';
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(-s * 1.8, realBodyY + s * 0.5);
    ctx.rotate(-0.3 + armSwingL * 0.06);
    ctx.fillRect(-s * 0.4, 0, s * 0.8, s * 2.2);
    // 手
    ctx.fillStyle = flash ? '#fff' : '#f5c6a0';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, s * 2.3, s * 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();

    // 右臂
    ctx.fillStyle = flash ? '#fff' : '#e74c3c';
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(s * 1.8, realBodyY + s * 0.5);
    ctx.rotate(0.3 + armSwingR * 0.06);
    ctx.fillRect(-s * 0.4, 0, s * 0.8, s * 2.2);
    ctx.fillStyle = flash ? '#fff' : '#f5c6a0';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, s * 2.3, s * 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();

    // 头
    const headY = realBodyY - s * 1.5;
    ctx.fillStyle = flash ? '#fff' : '#f5c6a0';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, headY, s * 1.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // 帽子
    ctx.fillStyle = flash ? '#fff' : '#e74c3c';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, headY - s * 0.3, s * 1.4, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // 帽檐
    ctx.fillStyle = flash ? '#fff' : '#c0392b';
    ctx.fillRect(-s * 1.6, headY - s * 0.3, s * 3.2, s * 0.3);
    // 帽子前沿
    ctx.fillStyle = flash ? '#fff' : '#e74c3c';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-s * 1.8, headY - s * 0.3);
    ctx.lineTo(s * 1.8, headY - s * 0.3);
    ctx.lineTo(s * 1.3, headY - s * 0.9);
    ctx.lineTo(-s * 1.3, headY - s * 0.9);
    ctx.fill();

    // 头发(从帽子下露出)
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a1a';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, headY + s * 0.8, s * 1.1, -0.2, Math.PI + 0.2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // ---- 滑板特效 ----
  if (PLAYER.skateboard && PLAYER.skateboardTimer > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(46,204,113,0.4)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, s * 1, s * 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2ecc71';
    ctx.fillRect(-s * 3, s * 1.4, s * 6, s * 0.4);
    ctx.fillRect(-s * 2.2, s * 1.6, s * 1, s * 0.3);
    ctx.fillRect(s * 1.2, s * 1.6, s * 1, s * 0.3);
  }

  // ---- 磁铁特效 ----
  if (PLAYER.magnetActive && PLAYER.magnetTimer > 0) {
    const pulse = Math.sin(frameCount * 0.3) * 0.3 + 0.5;
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(52,152,219,${pulse})`;
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, s * 0.5, s * 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(52,152,219,${pulse*0.5})`;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, s * 0.5, s * 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  ctx.restore();
}

// ============================================================
// 渲染: 障碍物
// ============================================================
function drawObstacle(obs) {
  const pw = PERSPECTIVE;
  const laneW = W() * 0.12 * pw.scaleAt(obs.screenY) * 3;
  const sx = W() * 0.5 + obs.lane * laneW;
  const sy = obs.screenY;
  const sc = pw.scaleAt(sy);
  const s = W() * 0.03 * sc;

  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(sx, sy);

  switch (obs.type) {
    case 'barrier':
      // 道口栏杆 - 横杆+柱子
      ctx.fillStyle = '#e74c3c';
      ctx.fillRect(-s * 5, -s * 0.8, s * 10, s * 1.6);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.fillRect(-s * 4.5, -s * 0.4, s * 2, s * 0.8);
      ctx.fillRect(s * 1.5, -s * 0.4, s * 2, s * 0.8);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
      ctx.fillRect(-s * 4, s * 0.8, s * 0.5, s * 3);
      ctx.fillRect(s * 3.5, s * 0.8, s * 0.5, s * 3);
      break;
    case 'pipe':
      // 横放铁管
      ctx.fillStyle = '#95a5a6';
      ctx.fillRect(-s * 4.5, -s * 0.6, s * 9, s * 1.2);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#7f8c8d';
      ctx.fillRect(-s * 4.5, -s * 0.6, s * 9, s * 0.3);
      break;
    case 'fence':
      // 低矮围栏
      ctx.fillStyle = '#f39c12';
      for (let fx = -s * 4; fx <= s * 4; fx += s * 1.2) {
        ctx.fillRect(fx, -s * 2, s * 0.3, s * 2);
      }
      ctx.fillRect(-s * 4.2, -s * 1.8, s * 8.4, s * 0.4);
      ctx.fillRect(-s * 4.2, -s * 0.8, s * 8.4, s * 0.4);
      break;
    case 'signalBox':
      // 信号灯箱
      ctx.fillStyle = '#2c3e50';
      ctx.fillRect(-s * 1.5, -s * 4, s * 3, s * 4);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#e74c3c';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, -s * 2.5, s, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#2ecc71';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, -s * 1, s, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      // 闪烁
      if (Math.sin(frameCount * 0.2) > 0) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0000';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(0, -s * 2.5, s * 0.7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }
      ctx.fillStyle = '#555';
      ctx.fillRect(-s * 0.3, -s * 0.2, s * 0.6, s * 3);
      break;
    case 'tiesPile':
      // 枕木堆
      ctx.fillStyle = '#8B4513';
      for (let tx = -s * 2.5; tx <= s * 2.5; tx += s * 1.5) {
        ctx.fillRect(tx, -s * (1.5 + Math.random() * 0.8), s * 1.4, s * 0.6);
      }
      ctx.fillRect(-s * 2.8, -s * 1, s * 5.6, s * 0.6);
      ctx.fillRect(-s * 2.2, -s * 1.8, s * 4.4, s * 0.6);
      break;
    case 'cone':
      // 施工锥桶
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6600';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, -s * 3);
      ctx.lineTo(-s * 1.5, s * 0.5);
      ctx.lineTo(s * 1.5, s * 0.5);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.fillRect(-s * 0.8, -s * 1.8, s * 1.6, s * 0.4);
      ctx.fillRect(-s * 0.6, -s * 0.6, s * 1.2, s * 0.4);
      break;
    case 'maintCart':
      // 维修车
      ctx.fillStyle = '#f1c40f';
      ctx.fillRect(-s * 3, -s * 2.5, s * 6, s * 3.5);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#e67e22';
      ctx.fillRect(-s * 2.5, -s * 2, s * 5, s * 2.5);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(-s * 2, s * 1.5, s * 0.8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(s * 2, s * 1.5, s * 0.8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      break;
    case 'tower':
      // 信号塔基座
      ctx.fillStyle = '#7f8c8d';
      ctx.fillRect(-s * 2.5, -s * 5, s * 5, s * 5.5);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#666';
      for (let ty = -s * 4.5; ty < s * 0.5; ty += s * 1.2) {
        ctx.fillRect(-s * 3, ty, s * 6, s * 0.3);
      }
      break;
    case 'worker':
      // 横穿工人(动态移动)
      const wx = Math.sin(frameCount * 0.05 + obs.wobble) * s * 3;
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6600';
      ctx.fillRect(wx - s, -s * 3.5, s * 2, s * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a2e';
      ctx.fillRect(wx - s, -s * 1.5, s * 2, s * 2.5);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#f5c6a0';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(wx, -s * 4, s, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#f39c12';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(wx, -s * 4.2, s * 1.2, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      break;
  }

  // 警告指示 (离玩家很近时)
  const playerScreenY = H() * PLAYER.y;
  if (sy > playerScreenY - H() * 0.05 && sy < playerScreenY + H() * 0.03 && !obs.passed) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,0,0,0.3)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, -s * 3, s * 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  ctx.restore();
}

// ============================================================
// 渲染: 火车
// ============================================================
function drawTrain(train) {
  const pw = PERSPECTIVE;
  const laneW = W() * 0.12 * pw.scaleAt(train.screenY) * 3;
  const sx = W() * 0.5 + train.lane * laneW;
  const sy = train.screenY;
  const sc = pw.scaleAt(sy);
  const s = W() * 0.03 * sc;

  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(sx, sy);

  // 火车头
  const headX = train.numCars * s * 4;
  ctx.fillStyle = train.color;
  ctx.fillRect(headX - s * 2, -s * 5, s * 4.5, s * 6);
  // 驾驶室窗
  ctx.fillStyle = '#87CEEB';
  ctx.fillRect(headX - s, -s * 4, s * 2.5, s * 2);
  // 车灯
  if (train.lightOn) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffff00';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(headX + s * 1.8, -s * 2, s * 0.8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // 光晕
    const glowGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(headX + s * 1.8, -s * 2, s * 0.3, headX + s * 1.8, -s * 2, s * 2);
    glowGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,100,0.6)');
    glowGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,0,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = glowGrad;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(headX + s * 1.8, -s * 2, s * 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  // 烟囱
  ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
  ctx.fillRect(headX - s * 0.5, -s * 6.5, s * 1.2, s * 1.8);

  // 车厢
  for (let c = 0; c < train.numCars; c++) {
    const cx = c * s * 4.5;
    ctx.fillStyle = train.color;
    ctx.fillRect(cx, -s * 4.5, s * 4.2, s * 5.5);
    // 车厢分隔线
    ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
    ctx.fillRect(cx + s * 4, -s * 4.5, s * 0.2, s * 5.5);
    // 车轮
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a1a';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx + s * 1, s * 1.5, s * 0.7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx + s * 3, s * 1.5, s * 0.7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // 涂鸦
    if ((c + train.graffiti) % 2 === 0) {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.font = `${s*1.5}px Arial`;
      ctx.fillText('WILD', cx + s * 0.3, -s * 2.5);
    } else if ((c + train.graffiti) % 3 === 0) {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
      ctx.font = `bold ${s*1.3}px Arial`;
      ctx.fillText('ART', cx + s * 0.5, -s * 1.5);
    }
  }

  // 可攀爬标记(车顶平台)
  if (train.climbable) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(100,200,100,0.5)';
    ctx.fillRect(-s, -s * 5.2, train.numCars * s * 4.7, s * 0.8);
  }

  // 火车名(涂鸦风格)
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = `bold ${s*1}px Arial`;
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('METRO', headX, -s * 3);

  ctx.restore();
}

// ============================================================
// 渲染: 道具
// ============================================================
function drawPowerup(pu) {
  const pw = PERSPECTIVE;
  const laneW = W() * 0.12 * pw.scaleAt(pu.screenY) * 3;
  const sx = W() * 0.5 + pu.lane * laneW;
  const sy = pu.screenY;
  const sc = pw.scaleAt(sy);
  const s = W() * 0.03 * sc;

  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(sx, sy);
  ctx.rotate(sy * 2 + pu.rotation); // 旋转效果
  const bob = Math.sin(frameCount * 0.08 + pu.bobOffset) * s * 0.5;
  ctx.translate(0, bob);

  switch (pu.type) {
    case 'coin':
      // 金币
      ctx.fillStyle = '#f1c40f';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, 0, s * 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#f39c12';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, 0, s * 1.1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#f1c40f';
      ctx.font = `bold ${s*1.8}px Arial`;
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
      ctx.fillText('$', 0, 0);
      break;
    case 'coinSilver':
      // 银币
      ctx.fillStyle = '#bdc3c7';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, 0, s * 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ecf0f1';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, 0, s * 1.1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#95a5a6';
      ctx.font = `bold ${s*1.8}px Arial`;
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
      ctx.fillText('$', 0, 0);
      break;
    case 'medkit':
      // 医疗包 - 白色方块+红十字
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.fillRect(-s * 1.8, -s * 1.8, s * 3.6, s * 3.6);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#e74c3c';
      ctx.fillRect(-s * 0.4, -s * 1.3, s * 0.8, s * 2.6);
      ctx.fillRect(-s * 1.3, -s * 0.4, s * 2.6, s * 0.8);
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#c0392b';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.strokeRect(-s * 1.8, -s * 1.8, s * 3.6, s * 3.6);
      break;
    case 'magnet':
      // 磁铁 - 蓝色U形
      ctx.fillStyle = '#3498db';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, s * 0.2, s * 2, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.lineWidth = s * 0.8;
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#3498db';
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#e74c3c';
      ctx.fillRect(-s * 1.8, -s * 0.3, s * 0.8, s * 1);
      ctx.fillRect(s * 1, -s * 0.3, s * 0.8, s * 1);
      break;
    case 'doubleCoin':
      // 双倍金币 - 金色星星
      ctx.fillStyle = '#f39c12';
      drawStar(0, 0, s * 1.8, s * 0.7, 5);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#f1c40f';
      drawStar(0, 0, s * 1.2, s * 0.45, 5);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.font = `bold ${s*1.2}px Arial`;
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
      ctx.fillText('x2', 0, 0);
      break;
    case 'skateboard':
      // 滑板 - 绿色
      ctx.fillStyle = '#2ecc71';
      ctx.fillRect(-s * 2.5, -s * 0.5, s * 5, s * 1);
      ctx.fillRect(-s * 2, s * 0.3, s * 1, s * 0.6);
      ctx.fillRect(s * 1, s * 0.3, s * 1, s * 0.6);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#27ae60';
      ctx.font = `bold ${s*1}px Arial`;
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
      ctx.fillText('SK8', 0, 0);
      break;
  }

  ctx.restore();
}

function drawStar(cx, cy, outerR, innerR, points) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  for (let i = 0; i < points * 2; i++) {
    const r = i % 2 === 0 ? outerR : innerR;
    const angle = (i * Math.PI) / points - Math.PI / 2;
    const x = cx + Math.cos(angle) * r;
    const y = cy + Math.sin(angle) * r;
    if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
    else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
  }
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
}

// ============================================================
// 渲染: 粒子
// ============================================================
function drawParticles() {
  for (const p of particles) {
    const alpha = p.life / p.maxLife;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color.replace(')', `,${alpha})`).replace('rgb', 'rgba');
    if (p.color.startsWith('#')) {
      const r = parseInt(p.color.slice(1, 3), 16);
      const g = parseInt(p.color.slice(3, 5), 16);
      const b = parseInt(p.color.slice(5, 7), 16);
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${r},${g},${b},${alpha})`;
    }
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * alpha, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawHUD() {
  const w = W();

    ctx.fillStyle = i < PLAYER.hp ? '#e74c3c' : '#555';

  // ---- 分数(顶部中央) ----
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';

  ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';

  ctx.fillRect(w * 0.905, h * 0.032, w * 0.012, w * 0.06);
  ctx.fillRect(w * 0.93, h * 0.032, w * 0.012, w * 0.06);

  // ---- 道具计时器 ----

    ctx.fillText(`磁铁 ${Math.ceil(PLAYER.magnetTimer)}s`, w * 0.04, timerY);
    timerY += w * 0.04;

    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText(`滑板 ${Math.ceil(PLAYER.skateboardTimer)}s`, w * 0.04, timerY);
  }
}

function drawHeart(x, y, size) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  const topY = y - size * 0.8;
  ctx.moveTo(x, topY + size * 1.5);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(x, topY + size * 0.5, x - size, topY, x - size * 0.5, topY + size * 0.2);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(x - size * 0.5, topY + size * 0.8, x, topY + size * 1.2, x, topY + size * 1.8);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(x, topY + size * 1.2, x + size * 0.5, topY + size * 0.8, x + size * 0.5, topY + size * 0.2);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(x + size, topY, x, topY + size * 0.5, x, topY + size * 1.5);
  ctx.fill();
}

function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.lineTo(x + w - r, y);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r);
  ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h);
  ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + h);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r);
  ctx.lineTo(x, y + r);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y);
  ctx.closePath();
}

// ============================================================
// 输入处理
// ============================================================
function handleInput(action) {
  if (gameState === STATE.MENU) {
    if (action === 'start' || action === 'jump' || action === 'slide') {
      startGame();
    }
    return;
  }
  if (gameState === STATE.DEAD) {
    if (action === 'start' || action === 'jump' || action === 'slide') {
      startGame();
    }
    return;
  }
  if (gameState !== STATE.PLAYING) return;

  switch (action) {
    case 'left':
      PLAYER.targetLane = Math.max(-1, PLAYER.targetLane - 1);
      break;
    case 'right':
      PLAYER.targetLane = Math.min(1, PLAYER.targetLane + 1);
      break;
    case 'jump':
      if (!PLAYER.isJumping && !PLAYER.isSliding) {
        PLAYER.isJumping = true;
        PLAYER.vy = -9;
        PLAYER.jumpHeight = 0;
        sfxJump();
      }
      break;
    case 'slide':
      if (!PLAYER.isJumping && !PLAYER.isSliding) {
        PLAYER.isSliding = true;
        PLAYER.slideTimer = 0.55;
        sfxSlide();
      }
      break;
  }
}

// 键盘
const keys = {};
window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  if (keys[e.code]) return;
  keys[e.code] = true;
  switch (e.code) {
    case 'ArrowLeft': case 'KeyA': handleInput('left'); break;
    case 'ArrowRight': case 'KeyD': handleInput('right'); break;
    case 'ArrowUp': case 'KeyW': handleInput('jump'); break;
    case 'ArrowDown': case 'KeyS': handleInput('slide'); break;
    case 'Space': handleInput('start'); break;
  }
  e.preventDefault();
});
window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.code] = false; });

// 触屏
let touchStartX = 0, touchStartY = 0, touchStartTime = 0;
window.addEventListener('touchstart', e => {
  const t = e.touches[0];
  touchStartX = t.clientX;
  touchStartY = t.clientY;
  touchStartTime = Date.now();
});
window.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
  const t = e.changedTouches[0];
  const dx = t.clientX - touchStartX;
  const dy = t.clientY - touchStartY;
  const dt = Date.now() - touchStartTime;

  if (Math.abs(dx) < 10 && Math.abs(dy) < 10 && dt < 300) {
    // Tap
    handleInput('start');
    return;
  }
  if (Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy) && Math.abs(dx) > 30) {
    handleInput(dx > 0 ? 'right' : 'left');
  } else if (Math.abs(dy) > 30) {
    handleInput(dy < 0 ? 'jump' : 'slide');
  }
});

// 点击(PC)
canvas.addEventListener('click', e => {
  if (gameState !== STATE.PLAYING) {
    handleInput('start');
  }
});

// ============================================================
// 游戏更新
// ============================================================
function update(dt) {
  if (gameState !== STATE.PLAYING) return;
  if (slowMotion > 0) {
    dt *= 0.3;
    slowMotion -= dt;
  }

  // 限制最大步长
  dt = Math.min(dt, 0.1);
  frameCount++;

  // ---- 速度 & 坡度 ----
  slopeTimer -= dt;
  if (slopeTimer <= 0) {
    targetSlope = rand(-0.6, 0.6);
    slopeTimer = rand(3, 7);
  }
  slopeValue = lerp(slopeValue, targetSlope, dt * 0.5);
  currentSpeed = speed * (1 - slopeValue * 0.25); // 上坡慢，下坡快
  currentSpeed = Math.max(150, Math.min(450, currentSpeed));

  // ---- 距离 & 分数 ----
  const distDelta = currentSpeed * dt;
  totalDistanceTraveled += distDelta;
  distance += distDelta;
  score += distDelta * 0.5;
  trackOffset += distDelta * 0.8;
  sceneOffset += distDelta * 0.3;

  // 每500米回血
  if (totalDistanceTraveled - lastHealDistance >= 500) {
    lastHealDistance = Math.floor(totalDistanceTraveled / 500) * 500;
    if (PLAYER.hp < PLAYER.maxHp) {
      PLAYER.hp = Math.min(PLAYER.maxHp, PLAYER.hp + 1);
      sfxHeal();
      spawnParticles(W() / 2, H() * PLAYER.y, 12, '#e74c3c');
    }
  }

  // ---- 跑道切换平滑过渡 ----
  PLAYER.lane = PLAYER.targetLane;
  PLAYER.currentLaneX = lerp(PLAYER.currentLaneX, PLAYER.lane, dt * 10);

  // ---- 跳跃 ----
  if (PLAYER.isJumping) {
    PLAYER.jumpHeight += PLAYER.vy * dt;
    PLAYER.vy += 25 * dt; // 重力
    if (PLAYER.jumpHeight >= 0) {
      PLAYER.jumpHeight = 0;
      PLAYER.vy = 0;
      PLAYER.isJumping = false;
    }
  }

  // ---- 滑铲 ----
  if (PLAYER.isSliding) {
    PLAYER.slideTimer -= dt;
    if (PLAYER.slideTimer <= 0) {
      PLAYER.isSliding = false;
    }
  }

  // ---- 无敌时间 ----
  if (PLAYER.invincible > 0) PLAYER.invincible -= dt;

  // ---- 道具计时器 ----
  if (PLAYER.magnetTimer > 0) { PLAYER.magnetTimer -= dt; if (PLAYER.magnetTimer <= 0) PLAYER.magnetActive = false; }

  o.type=ty; o.frequency.setValueAtTime(f,t);

  // 弧形地平线: y = baseY + arc*sin²(π·x/W)
  horizonY(x){
    const base = H*0.2;
    const arc = H*0.015 * Math.pow(Math.sin(Math.PI*x/W), 2);

  z:0.35, // 世界深度(固定，玩家位置)
  vy:0, jH:0, jumping:false, // 跳跃

};
function rP(){
  P.lane=0;P.tgtLane=0;P.curLX=0;P.z=0.35;P.vy=0;P.jH=0;P.jumping=false;
  P.sliding=false;P.slideT=0;P.hp=3;P.inv=0;
  P.magnet=false;P.magnetT=0;P.dblCoin=false;P.dblCoinT=0;P.skate=false;P.skateT=0;

// ── 对象池 ────────────────────────────────────────
let obs=[], pups=[], trains=[], parts=[], floatTxts=[], speedLines=[];

let spawnT=0, pupSpawnT=0, trainSpawnT=0, nxtTrain=6;
let lastHealD=0, totalD=0;

// ── 辅助 ──────────────────────────────────────────
function R(a,b){ return Math.random()*(b-a)+a; }
function RI(a,b){ return Math.floor(R(a,b+1)); }
function L(a,b,t){ return a+(b-a)*t; }
function CL(v,lo,hi){ return Math.max(lo,Math.min(hi,v)); }

// ── 浮动文字 ──────────────────────────────────────
function addFloat(x,y,text,color,size=1){
  floatTxts.push({x,y,text,color,life:1.2,size,vx:R(-0.3,0.3),vy:-1.5});
}

// ── 粒子 ──────────────────────────────────────────
function addParts(x,y,n,color,spd=2){
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const a=R(0,Math.PI*2), s=R(spd*0.4,spd);
    parts.push({x,y,vx:Math.cos(a)*s,vy:Math.sin(a)*s-R(1,3),life:R(0.3,0.7),maxL:0.7,color,sz:R(2,5)});
  }
}

// ── 速度线(表现向前运动感) ───────────────────────
function addSpeedLine(){
  const lane=RI(-1,1);
  const z=R(0.05,0.95);
  const sy=VP.screenY(z);
  const sx=VP.laneX(lane,sy)+R(-5,5);
  speedLines.push({x:sx,y:sy,life:R(0.3,0.9),maxL:0.9,len:R(8,25)});
}

// 障碍类型: action=0滑铲 1跳跃 2换道
const OB_DEF = {
  // ── 低矮障碍（滑铲通过） ──
  barrier:{name:'道口栏杆',action:0,color:'#e74c3c',h:0.15},
  pipe:{name:'横置铁管',action:0,color:'#95a5a6',h:0.12},
  lowFence:{name:'低矮围栏',action:0,color:'#f39c12',h:0.18},
  wire:{name:'绊脚电缆',action:0,color:'#e67e22',h:0.1},
  // ── 中等障碍（跳跃越过） ──
  signal:{name:'信号灯箱',action:1,color:'#2c3e50',h:0.45},
  ties:{name:'枕木堆',action:1,color:'#8B4513',h:0.4},
  barrel:{name:'油桶',action:1,color:'#e74c3c',h:0.42},
  coneWall:{name:'锥桶阵列',action:1,color:'#ff6600',h:0.38},
  // ── 高大障碍（必须换道） ──
  cart:{name:'维修平板车',action:2,color:'#f1c40f',h:0.7},
  tower:{name:'信号塔基座',action:2,color:'#7f8c8d',h:0.85},
  worker:{name:'施工工人',action:2,color:'#ff6600',h:0.75},
};

function spawnOb(){
  // 保证三种操作类型均匀分布
  const r=R(0,1);
  let cat; // 0=low 1=mid 2=high
  if(r<0.35) cat=0; else if(r<0.65) cat=1; else cat=2;
  const candidates=Object.entries(OB_DEF).filter(([_,d])=>d.action===cat);
  const [typeName,def]=candidates[RI(0,candidates.length-1)];
  const lane=RI(-1,1);
  // 避免同跑道堆叠
  for(const o of obs){ if(o.lane===lane&&o.z>0.6) return; }
  obs.push({
    type:typeName, lane, z:0.02, color:def.color, action:def.action,
    h:def.h, passed:false, wob:0,
  });
}

// ║  火车系统 — 可占1或2道，始终留安全通道            ║
// ╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝

function spawnTrain(){
  const colors=['#c0392b','#2980b9','#27ae60','#f39c12','#1a1a1a'];
  const color=colors[RI(0,colors.length-1)];
  const twoLane=Math.random()<0.45; // 45%概率双道火车

  let lane, width; // width=1或2
  if(twoLane){
    // 占2道：(-1,0)或(0,1)，始终留一道安全
    lane=Math.random()<0.5?-1:0; // 起始道
    width=2;
  } else {
    lane=RI(-1,1);
    width=1;
  }

  const numCars=width===2?RI(2,4):(Math.random()<0.3?RI(3,5):RI(1,2));
  const climbable=width===1&&Math.random()<0.35;

  // 避免重叠
  for(const t of trains){
    if(t.z>0.5&&Math.abs(t.lane-lane)<width) return;
  }

  trains.push({
    lane,width,numCars,color,climbable,
    z:0.02, hornT:R(1.5,3), lightT:0,
    graffiti:RI(0,2),
  });
}

// ║  渲染: 天空 + 弧形地平线城市                        ║
